meta.title: Sign-in security
meta.description: Add a second step to signing in to Friends of Animals.

account.title: Sign-in security
account.lead: Add a second step to signing in: a code from an authenticator app, or a passkey on your device.
account.staffNeedsFactor: Your staff role needs a second step. Add an authenticator app or a passkey to open staff pages.
account.staffNeedsVerify: Enter your second step to open staff pages.
account.none: You haven't added a second step yet.
account.removed: Removed. It no longer works for signing in.
account.added: Added. You'll use it to confirm it's you.
account.continue: Continue to the page you were on

totp.title: Add an authenticator app
totp.lead: Use an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password on your phone.

label.label: Name it
label.hint: So you can tell your devices apart, like “Work phone”.
label.error: Give it a name of up to 60 characters.

totp.scan: Scan this code with your app.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for adding Friends of Animals to an authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan it? Type this setup key into the app instead:

code.label: 6-digit code
code.hint: Enter the code your app shows now.
code.error: Enter the 6 digits your app shows.

totp.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Check the app shows Friends of Animals, then try the code it shows now.
totp.expired: That setup has ended. Start again.

passkey.title: Add a passkey
passkey.lead: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock on this device. Passkeys here must check it's you, not just that someone is there.

label.label: Name it
label.error: Give it a name of up to 60 characters.

passkey.unsupported: This browser can't make passkeys. Use an authenticator app instead.
passkey.failed: Your device didn't make a passkey. Try again, or use an authenticator app.
passkey.notVerified: Your device didn't check it's you with a PIN, fingerprint or face. Passkeys here need that.

meta.title: Enter your second step
meta.description: Confirm it's you with your authenticator app or passkey.

verify.title: Enter your second step
verify.lead: Staff pages need a code from your authenticator app, or your passkey, once each time you sign in.

meta.title: Confirm it's you
meta.description: Confirm it's you before a sensitive change.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.lead: This change needs a fresh second step. It then counts for {minutes} minutes.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.error: Enter the 6 digits your app shows.

form.noFactor: You haven't added a second step yet.

alerts.wrong_code: That code didn't match. Try the code your app shows now.
alerts.code_used: That code was just used. Wait for your app to show the next one.
alerts.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
alerts.not_enrolled: You haven't added an authenticator app. Use your passkey instead.
alerts.not_verified: Your passkey didn't confirm it's you. Try again.
alerts.challenge_expired: That took too long. Try again.
alerts.passkey_failed: Your device didn't use the passkey. Try again, or enter a code.
